responsibility: Implements the Resolver2_0 Rib abstraction used as the per-scope binding table inside ForeverStack nodes. This file defines how a Rib stores names as either shadowable or non-shadowable Definition objects, merges or rejects duplicate insertions according to Rust shadowing rules, represents ambiguous shadowable results such as competing imports, and exposes simple lookup and formatting helpers used by the namespace stacks and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Implements Rib and Rib::Definition behavior, including duplicate-handling, shadowable-vs-non-shadowable insertion rules, ambiguity tracking for merged shadowable imports, lookup, and string formatting; the paired header declares the Rib types, Namespace enum, and insert/get API.
